concepts.name: Organic Chemistry
concepts.simple_definition: Organic chemistry is the scientific study of carbon-based compounds, their structures, and reactions.
concepts.deep_explanation: Carbon can form four covalent bonds, allowing it to create complex chains and rings (catenation). Most organic compounds contain carbon and hydrogen.
concepts.real_example: Methane (CH4) and ethanol (C2H5OH) are basic organic chemical compounds.
concepts.common_confusion: Thinking all carbon compounds are organic. CO2 and carbonates are classified as inorganic.
concepts.simple_definition_amharic: ኦርጋኒክ ኬሚስትሪ ማለት በካርቦን ላይ የተመሰረቱ ውህዶችን፣ አወቃቀራቸውን እና ግብረመልሳቸውን የሚያጠና የሳይንስ ዘርፍ ነው።
concepts.deep_explanation_amharic: ካርቦን አራት የጋራ ኤሌክትሮን ትስስር (covalent bonds) መሥራት የሚችል ሲሆን ረጅም ሰንሰለቶችን መፍጠር ይችላል።
concepts.real_example_amharic: ሜቴን (CH4) እና ኢታኖል (C2H5OH) መሠረታዊ ኦርጋኒክ ውህዶች ናቸው።
concepts.common_confusion_amharic: ሁሉም የካርቦን ውህዶች ኦርጋኒክ ናቸው ብሎ ማሰብ። CO2 እና ካርቦኔቶች ኢንኦርጋኒክ ናቸው።

concepts.name: 169 Energy Changes And Electrochemistry
concepts.simple_definition: 169 Energy Changes and Electrochemistry Note that the total energy of the universe remains constant
concepts.deep_explanation: When the system loses a certain amount of energy, the surrounding gains the same amount of energy
concepts.real_example: Practical example of 169 Energy Changes and Electrochemistry  from page 175.
concepts.common_confusion: Students sometimes confuse 169 Energy Changes and Electrochemistry  with adjacent topics in Chapter 1.
concepts.simple_definition_amharic: [አማርኛ] 169 Energy Changes and Electrochemistry Note that the total energy of the universe remains constant (ይህ ትርጓሜ በኢትዮጵያ የ10ኛ ክፍል ሥርዓተ-ትምህርት መሠረት የተዘጋጀ ነው)።
concepts.deep_explanation_amharic: [አማርኛ ማብራሪያ] When the system loses a certain amount of energy, the surrounding gains the same amount of energy — ይህ ጽንሰ-ሐሳብ ተማሪዎች በክፍል ውስጥ የተማሩትን በቀላሉ እንዲረዱ ይረዳቸዋል።
concepts.real_example_amharic: [አማርኛ] በገጽ 175 ላይ ያለውን ተግባራዊ ምሳሌ ይመልከቱ።
concepts.common_confusion_amharic: [አማርኛ] ተማሪዎች ይህንን ጽንሰ-ሐሳብ ከሌሎች ተዛማጅ ርዕሶች ጋር ሊያደናግሩ ይችላሉ።

concepts.name: From Your Discussion On Activity 4.2, Yo
concepts.simple_definition: From your discussion on Activity 4.2, you can conclude that reactions that cause the surrounding to heat up are called heat releasing reactions and the process is exothermic
concepts.deep_explanation: Reactions that take up energy from the surrounding such as the reaction flask are called heat absorbing and the process is endothermic

concepts.name: Example, A Substance With A Low Heat Cap
concepts.simple_definition: example, a substance with a low heat capacity, such as iron, will heat and cool quickly, while a substance with a high heat capacity, such as water, heats and cools slowly
